summary_1line: Pulastya continues listing sacred pilgrimage sites and their spiritual rewards, culminating in an extended praise of Prayaga and the purifying power of the Ganga.

image_candidates.scene_text: At Prayaga, the rivers Ganga and Yamuna visibly merge while sages, gods, and celestial beings gather around the sacred confluence.
A pilgrim stands waist‑deep in the flowing Ganga at sunrise, offering water to the gods and ancestors as mist rises from the river.
On the mountain Sree, Mahadeva sits beside the goddess while Brahma and other gods assemble around a sacred lake.
